messages:
Carla (Acme Corp): Hey team — customer reports invoice >> SDK estimate for a chat session. SDK/local estimator shows 44 tokens but invoice line items add up to 78. Repro attached, can someone help? :confused:

Alice (Support): Thanks, Carla. Can you paste the exact curl or SDK snippet you used, the estimator output, and the invoice line item (request-id)? Also which model and whether you used streaming?

Carla (Acme Corp): Simplified curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-rt-large\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"system\",\"content\":\"You are helpful.\"},{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Summarize the following...\"}], \"stream\": true}'
```
Estimator returned `tokens_estimate: 41` for the prompt and `completion_estimate: 3` => total 44. Invoice shows 78 with two extra line items called `runtime-prefill` and `kv-metadata` for the same request-id.

Ben (Metering): Do you run any server-side toolchain/reranker or have streaming resume enabled? We recently shipped a change that can inject prefill fragments (system/tool prefixes and opaque KV metadata) for streaming/resume and certain tool integrations; the client estimator currently doesn't account for server-inserted tokens.

Carla (Acme Corp): We do have a small reranker that runs as a function in the toolchain stage. The app calls the same endpoint above; no explicit prefill in the client.

Alice (Support): That sounds like a likely cause. If the server injects a system prefill or KV entries for the toolchain, they will be billed even if the client estimator doesn't see them. Can you share the invoice request-id (PM if sensitive)? Ben — do we have a debug hook to echo billed token segments?

Ben (Metering): Yes — we can run `POST /internal/metering/debug` (internal) with the request-id; it returns the tokenized segments we billed: prompt, server_prefill, kv_metadata, streaming_padding, completion. If sharing publicly isn't possible, PM me the ID and I'll run it.

Carla (Acme Corp): PMing the invoice id now (req_0a9b-2024-05-12).

metering-bot: Debug output for req_0a9b-2024-05-12: 
- prompt_tokens: 41
- completion_tokens: 3
- injected_prefill_tokens: 12 (system/tool prefill)
- kv_metadata_tokens: 18
- streaming_resume_padding: 4
=> total billed tokens: 78

Alice (Support): That matches the invoice delta. Workarounds: 1) disable the server-side reranker for affected calls; 2) use the non-instrumented endpoint (dedicated route) that doesn't inject KV prefill; or 3) request a temporary billing review while we patch.

Carla (Acme Corp): For immediate mitigation, can you confirm which SDK configuration flags would opt out? We don't want to disable the reranker permanently.

Ben (Metering): There's an internal flag `server_prefill_opt_out=true` available on the dedicated endpoint; not yet exposed in open SDKs. Short term we can route this team's traffic to the opt-out path. Longer term we will update the client estimator to approximate server-injected segments or provide an SDK hook to request a preflight tokenization that includes server-side additions.

Ezra (Billing): We can issue a one-off pro-rated credit for the unexpected injected tokens for this billing period while engineering ships the fix. Please open a billing support ticket with the invoice id and I'll attach the debug output.

Ben (Metering): Filed internal engineering bug MTR-4212: "client estimator does not account for server-injected prefill & kv metadata (streaming/resume)". Assigned to eng-runtime. Initial ETA: 2 weeks for estimator update, 1 week for routing workaround.

Alice (Support): Thanks everyone. Carla, I'll coordinate the routing workaround and follow up on credit + ETA tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Carla (Acme Corp): Appreciate it — thanks all!
